description: This file defines a sealed class 'InterlockedFlag' used for thread-safe flag management, utilizing Interlocked.CompareExchange for atomic operations. It includes methods to check if the flag is set, attempt to set it, and throw exceptions if the object is not properly initialized or disposed.

classes.name: InterlockedFlag
classes.description: A thread-safe flag class that uses atomic operations to manage a boolean state.

methods.name: InterlockedFlag
methods.description: Constructor initializing the flag to false (0).

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Property indicating whether the flag is set.

methods.name: TrySet
methods.description: Attempts to set the flag atomically; returns true if successful.

methods.name: ThrowNotInitializedIfSet
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException if the flag is set, indicating improper access.

methods.name: ThrowDisposedIfSet
methods.description: Throws ObjectDisposedException if the flag is set, indicating the object has been disposed.
